records.deidentified_narrative: unit 1 (txlp# [identifier]) was driving inside the heb parking lot (center parking lot). unit 1 pulled into a parking space. unit 2 was originally inside her vehicle (txlp#[identifier]). unit 2 drove her vehicle forward through the parking space. unit 2 intended to exit her parking space by driving through another parking space. unit 1 wanted to park in the parking spot that unit 2 [roadway] through. unit 2 who is also a pedestrian got out of her vehicle and approached unit 1. the two parties began to argue. unit 1 advised unit 2 to back out of her space. unit 2 responded that she is handicapped and that she cannot back out of her parking space, therefore she needs to exit the parking space by driving through the divided line. after unit 2 got out of her vehicle, unit 2 advised unit 1 creeped up into the parking space. unit 2 advised unit 1 rolled on top of her right foot with the driver side front tire. unit 2 complained of pain to her right foot but [medical facility] at a later time. there was no damage to unit 1. unit 2 advised she did not believe unit 1 intentionally ran over her foot, but wanted this documented. witness 1- evan who is an heb employee was pushing carts when he heard an argument going on between unit 1 and unit 2. evan advised that he heard unit 2 yelled ""you are on my foot"" multiple times to unit 1. evan stated due to where he was in the parking lot, he did not see whether unit 1 was on top of unit 2's right foot. evan advised he observed unit 1 backed out of the parking space. witness 2- witness advised he was sitting in his parked car next to an empty parking space. unit 2's vehicle pulled into the parking spot at the same time when unit 1 drove directly in front of it. unit 2's vehicle crossed the dividing line between the parking space attempting to exit into the adjacent isle. unit 2's vehicle couldn't exit the parking space as unit 1 [roadway] into the space. unit 2 (pedestrian) exited the vehicle and approached unit 1. unit 2 asked unit 1 whether or not unit 1 can reverse her vehicle so unit 2 can cut across as unit 2 has difficulty reversing. unit 2 advised unit 1 that she did not need to do that as unit 1 was attempting to park in the open parking space. witness stated that as unit 1 was pulling further into the parking spot, unit 2 placed her right foot in front of unit 1's front tire and began alleging that unit 1 ran unit 2's foot over. witness stated that unit 1 intentionally placed her right foot in front of unit 1's driver side front tire. i, officer law, went into the heb office and watched the camera positioned towards the parking lot. at approximately 1805 hours, unit 1 pulled into the parking space. unit 2 got out of her vehicle at approximately 1806 hours. at 1807 hours, unit 1 pulled out of the parking space. the video quality wasn't clear enough to see whether unit 1 moved forward and drove over unit 2's foot. no further information at this timelaw8718witness information:tan, evanbustos, rafael

records.deidentified_narrative: this is traffic fatality #114 for the city of dallas in the year 2023. unit 1 was [roadway] [roadway]. unit 2, a pedestrian, crossed the [roadway] and was not in a crosswalk. as a result, unit 1 collided front right to unit 2 [roadway]. unit 2 was thrown approximately 60 feet from the area of impact. video evidence from a nearby business showed that unit 1 quickly steered to the left after colliding with unit 2 and fled the scene westbound without stopping to render aid to unit 2. (see related dallas p. d. offense report [identifier]-2023.) unit 3, also [roadway], drove over unit 2 after the initial collision due to unit 2 laying in the roadway. this second impact dragged unit 2 an additional 70 feet south. unit 2 was found to have no signs of life by dallas fire rescue 59 at 3:45am. unit 2 died as a result of injuries sustained in the collision. a 3d laser scan was completed, and the traffic drone was deployed at the scene. vehicle crimes unit detectives and supervisor responded to the scene. the medical examiner also responded to the scene on medical examiner [case id]. photos and body worn camera footage were uploaded to evidence. com on incident #23-2035222. this investigation is incomplete pending the identification of units 1 and 3. unit 2 was identified by the dallas county medical examiner. *supplement was created to reflect the blood toxicology results of unit 2. unit 2 was under the influence of drugs at the time of the collision.*

records.public_safe_text: police responded to unit 2's location under sapd-2023-1548902. unit 1 had called in and stated that she had tracked her daughter's cellphone to the location. unit 1 confronted unit 2 and o1 at their residence and they advised her that they did not know anything about her phone. unit 2 and o1 then get into their vehicle and leave their residence. unit 1 then proceeds to follow unit 2 and o1 to the listed location. another call came in stating that a female had been dragged by a vehicle at the location and the description of the vehicle matched the description of the vehicle that unit 1 had called in and stated that she was driving. i relocated to the listed location and contacted unit 2 and o1 there. unit 2 confirmed that unit 1 had confronted them regarding a cellphone. unit 2 stated that unit 1 showed up and accused them of taking her cellphone. unit 2 stated that she advised her that they did not have it. unit 2 stated that o1 and herself then got in their vehicle and left their residence. unit 2 stated that they needed gas so they pulled into the listed location. unit 2 stated that unit 1 was following them and she pulled up next to them. unit 2 stated that they were exchanging words and stated that she gets animated when she talks and uses her hands a lot so she thinks that unit 1 mistook that as a sign of aggression. unit 2 stated that she approached unit 1's vehicle along with o1, and all of the sudden unit 1 pepper sprayed her and o1 from within her vehicle as she was sitting in the driver's seat. unit 2 stated that they began to argue with unit 1 even more and unit 1 began to close her driver's door and she reached to grab the door and unit 1 closed the door on her right hand and she couldn't take it out. unit 2 stated that unit 1 then lowered her window and pepper sprayed her again [roadway] [roadway] away. unit 2 stated that unit 1 drove off and she was being dragged by the vehicle. unit 2 stated that after [roadway], her hand broke free from the door and unit 1 fled the scene. ems made the scene to treat unit 2's injuries: road rash to her mid back, cuts to her right hand and left elbow. tid detective was contacted and informed them of the incident who advised me to document the incident as listed. csi made the scene and took photos of unit 2's injuries. unit 1 did not return to the scene. unit 2 was released at the scene by ems. no further action was taken at this time.
